entities.name: Query GlmU-like protein
observations: 471 aa bacterial protein; estimated molecular mass 50.15 kDa and theoretical pI 5.58.
Sequence matches reviewed GlmU homologs at 42.5–53.0% identity with 96.2–98.3% query coverage and E-values 7.6e-116 to 7.7e-154.
Architecture is consistent with an N-terminal pyrophosphorylase domain, linker, and C-terminal glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase domain.
Likely catalyzes the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homology rather than directly measured for this sequence.

entities.name: GlmU
observations: Reviewed bacterial GlmU proteins are bifunctional enzymes catalyzing glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase and UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activities.
Representative reviewed homologs are cytoplasmic homotrimers and bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit.
Representative EC assignments are EC 2.3.1.157 and EC 2.7.7.23.

entities.name: GlmU acetylation reaction
observations: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H(+). Rhea RHEA:13725.
This is the C-terminal N-acetyltransferase reaction of GlmU.

entities.name: GlmU pyrophosphorylase reaction
observations: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H(+) = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate. Rhea RHEA:13509.
This is the N-terminal UDP-GlcNAc diphosphorylase reaction of GlmU.

entities.name: Magnesium ion cofactor
observations: Reviewed GlmU homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; GO annotation includes magnesium ion binding.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis
observations: GlmU catalyzes the last two sequential reactions in de novo UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis, contributing to peptidoglycan and, in appropriate bacteria, lipid A biosynthesis.
